info.name: Inithium API
info.description: CRUD engine API covering auth, file management, and the users / assets / collection-definitions / pages collections. Run "Auth > Admin Login" first to populate the auth_cookie collection variable used by every other authenticated request.

request.description: Verifies the API process is up and can respond to requests. No authentication required.
Authenticates an admin user and captures the access_token cookie into the auth_cookie collection variable for use by every other request in this collection.

exec: // The API issues httpOnly "access_token" / "refresh_token" cookies via
// Set-Cookie headers rather than returning them in the JSON body.
// Pull the access token out of the raw Set-Cookie header(s) first (works
// even when Postman's cookie jar is disabled or the domain doesn't
// match), falling back to the cookie jar if it is enabled.

request.description: Self-service registration. Issues the same auth cookies as Admin Login on success.

Relies on the httpOnly refresh_token cookie set at login, so it only works when Postman's cookie jar has captured it (this collection captures access_token explicitly; refresh_token is left to Postman's cookie jar).
